scope: Battery-cooling vertical example. Asset, batch, production and incident identities prefixed DEMO are synthetic; no installed railway or physical test is claimed.

design_items.title: Battery coolant circulation pump design
design_items.decomposition_rationale: Shaft seizure is safety significant; bearing, seal and supplier internal analysis still require review.

design_items.title: Battery coolant hose connection design
design_items.decomposition_rationale: Analyse seal loss and assembly torque error explicitly; supplier materials and torque remain open.

design_items.title: Coolant flow diagnostic design
design_items.decomposition_rationale: Stuck-high reading can mask circulation loss; physical flow measurement is outside current controller model.

design_items.title: Battery cooling loop design
design_items.decomposition_rationale: Pump, hose connector and flow diagnostics decomposed for this example; chiller supplier analysis remains open.

design_items.title: Reference railway operational boundary
design_items.decomposition_rationale: Engineering operating boundary; project route, recovery, evacuation and civil configuration remain deployment inputs.

functions.title: Control safe stopping, recovery and passenger conditions

configurations.initial_state: normal-running at 50 C ambient, reported hottest cell 30 C; one controller evaluation

hazards.consequence: Cooling loss can contribute to battery overheating/fire; isolation and containment require physical validation.
Traction isolation can strand a train; separation, recovery and passenger conditions require deployment evidence.

requirements.statement: A reported unavailable battery pump requests isolation and traction derating, with pump demand zero, in one controller evaluation.
A reported pressure failure requests isolation and zero pump demand in one controller evaluation.
Reported hottest-cell temperature at or above the 55 C reference trip threshold requests isolation and derating.
Selected supplier cooling design meets independently reviewed flow, hotspot and fault-detection limits.
Cooling connection installation records controlled supplier torque, calibrated tool and inspection before release.
Cooling isolation leads to a safe operating state with reviewed separation, passenger conditions and recovery.
